name: Melenas' Head
summary: At Fel Rock, Melenas' Head brings Lord Melenas' threat to an end. The satyr commander was encamped there, and the head is proof of his death.

sections.title: An Unspoken Disgrace
sections.body:
Satyrs on Teldrassil's new World Tree shame the night elves who guard Shadowglen and the lands around it. Lord Melenas made his lair in Fel Rock's twisted caverns, just north of the elven settlements. There he rallied aggressive grell warriors to his banner.

The kaldorei prize discretion when corruption draws so near their heartlands. Melenas' Head is private proof that his schemes ended before his influence could spread.

faq.answer: Lord Melenas was a satyr commander who lurked in Fel Rock on Teldrassil. He gathered grell warriors under his command to plot against nearby kaldorei outposts.

faq.q: Why must his death remain quiet?
faq.answer: Satyrs are ancient night elves, cursed and twisted by demonic corruption. Their presence so near Teldrassil's sacred boughs deeply embarrasses kaldorei authorities. Dealing with Melenas swiftly and quietly prevents panic and limits the shame.

faq.q: Where was Melenas' Head taken from?
faq.answer: Melenas' Head was taken deep inside Fel Rock, a corrupted cavern just north of Dolanaar in central Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know satyrs are a tragic demonic corruption of your ancient lineage. Lord Melenas' quiet execution was necessary, yet a source of cultural shame.
As a warrior, you know a severed enemy warlord's head gives unmistakable proof that a dangerous adversary and his grell host have been broken.
